# `⍒` — Grade down

Keys: `Alt-Backslash g`

`⍒Y` gives indices that sort major cells descending. Stable, with the same [ordering](grade-up.qmd) as Grade up.

```bpl
⍒30 10 20          ⍝ [0 2 1]ₓ
⍒2 1 2 1           ⍝ [0 2 1 3]ₓ
```

`C⍒Y` uses character collation `C`.

```bpl
"cba"⍒"abc"        ⍝ [0 1 2]ₓ
```
